login.title: Connect to your assistant
login.text: This browser could not be recognized automatically. Paste the Kreafinity access token.
login.invalid: Token refused. Check it and try again.
error.network: Kreafinity does not answer. Is the daemon running?
error.busy: A request is already running in this conversation.
error.keyring_unavailable: No system keyring is available on this computer.
sidebar.waiting: An action is waiting for your approval
conversation.delete_confirm: Delete the conversation "{title}"? This cannot be undone.
picker.key_missing: The {provider} API key is not set up.
welcome.title: Hello {name}, what can I do for you?
welcome.text: I can find and organize your files, open your applications or tell you about your computer. Nothing is changed without your approval.
welcome.suggestion.1: Show me the 5 largest files in my Downloads folder
welcome.suggestion.2: How is my computer doing? (CPU, memory, disk)
welcome.suggestion.4: Create a "Projects" folder in my Documents
composer.hint: Every action on your computer is shown to you before it happens.
tool.list_directory.help: List the files of a folder.
tool.list_applications.help: List the applications of the computer.
tool.move_file.help: Move or rename a file or folder.
tool.open_file.help: Open a file with its application.
tool.open_url.help: Open an address in the browser.
tool.move_to_trash.help: Send files to the trash (they can be restored).
tool.set_volume.help: Set the volume, mute or unmute.
tool.set_brightness.help: Set the brightness of a laptop's screen.
tool.run_command.help: Run a command with your rights (shown in full before it runs).
tool.install_package.help: Install system packages; the system asks for your administrator password.
approval.confirm_check: I checked the list and I confirm
approval.expired: Too late: the action was denied.
approval.elsewhere: An action is waiting for your approval in another conversation.
notice.iteration_limit: Request stopped: the step limit was reached.
notice.max_tokens: Answer cut off: the length limit was reached.
notice.provider_auth: The API key of this provider is missing or refused.
notice.provider_unavailable: The AI provider cannot be reached: {message}
settings.title: Settings
settings.ai.title: Artificial intelligence
settings.ai.text: Choose the AI used by default, and the one taking over when the Internet does not answer.
settings.keys.title: API keys
settings.keys.text: Keys are kept in the system keyring, never in a file.
settings.keys.no_keyring: No system keyring is available on this computer: use the environment variables shown.
settings.keys.label: {provider} API key
settings.tools.title: Allowed tools
settings.tools.text: What the AI can do on your computer. Actions needing approval are shown to you first, except those you allowed for good.
settings.folders.title: Accessible folders
settings.folders.text: One folder per line (~ is your home folder). Sensitive folders (.ssh, keyrings…) always stay off-limits.
settings.general.title: General
update.title: A Kreafinity update is available
update.restarting: Kreafinity will restart; this page reloads by itself.
update.too_long: The update takes longer than expected. Reload the page in a few minutes.
settings.updates.dev: Development copy: update it with git.
settings.memory.title: Memory
settings.memory.text: Kreafinity remembers you from one conversation to the next and learns from each one. Everything stays on this computer; you can read, fix or erase it all.
settings.memory.no_skills: None yet: Kreafinity saves some after multi-step tasks.
settings.memory.forget_confirm: Erase everything Kreafinity remembers (notes, skills and the personality it built)? Your conversations are kept.
tool.memory.help: Remember what is useful from one conversation to the next (preferences, corrections).
tool.skill.help: Save and improve procedures that worked.
tool.search_conversations.help: Recall what was said in past conversations.
settings.memory.soul_text: Kreafinity's character, written by itself. It grows it as you talk; you can also edit it. It changes how it speaks, never its rules.
settings.memory.soul_seed: Starting personality: Kreafinity has not grown it yet.
settings.memory.soul_reset_confirm: Give Kreafinity back its original personality? The one it built will be erased.
settings.memory.soul_was_reset: Kreafinity is back to its original personality.
tool.soul.help: Grow its own personality as you talk.
tool.set_appearance.help: Light, dark or Kreafinity theme, and wallpaper (KDE Plasma, GNOME).
tool.arrange_window.help: Bring a window forward, minimize, maximize or snap it left or right (KDE Plasma).
voice.busy: Kreafinity is listening to what you said…
voice.not_ready: Voice is not ready yet: prepare it in the settings.
voice.preparing: Voice is being prepared, one moment…
voice.no_microphone: The microphone cannot be used: check that it is plugged in and allowed.
voice.nothing_heard: I heard nothing. Try again, a little louder.
voice.failed: I could not understand the recording: {message}
settings.voice.title: Voice
settings.voice.text: Talk to Kreafinity with the microphone button, and it answers aloud. On this computer, your voice never leaves the machine.
settings.voice.installing: Installing the voice engines… (a few minutes)
settings.voice.ready_listening: Recognition is ready; the reading voice is not installed.
settings.voice.missing: Voice is not installed on this computer yet (about 600 MB to download).
settings.updates.managed: Kreafinity was installed from a system package: its updates come with the system's.
tool.look_at_screen.help: Take a screenshot to guide you (with your consent every time).
tool.browser_open.help: Open a page in a separate window, without your passwords or history (with your approval).
tool.browser_read.help: Read the text, links and buttons of the page the assistant opened.
tool.browser_point: Assistant's browser: show where to click
tool.browser_point.help: Frame a button or a field and show a bubble to guide you.
tool.browser_act.help: Click, fill in a field, scroll (with your approval; never passwords or bank cards).
tool.pilot_start.help: Let the assistant drive the mouse and keyboard, with a visible banner (explicit approval every time; Escape or the mouse to take back control).
tool.pilot_act.help: The assistant's moves in pilot mode (never in a terminal or in Kreafinity).
tool.pilot_stop.help: Give the mouse and keyboard back when the task is done.
onboarding.intro.title: Welcome to Kreafinity
onboarding.intro.text: Your computer now has an assistant: talk or write to it, it takes care of the rest.
onboarding.intro.files: Find, sort and clean up your files
onboarding.intro.apps: Open your applications, set the volume, brightness, theme
onboarding.intro.screen: Look at the screen to guide you, or do it for you
onboarding.intro.safe: Nothing happens without your approval, and you choose your AI
onboarding.choose.title: Which artificial intelligence?
onboarding.choose.text: Choose the AI that will run the assistant. You can change it at any time without losing anything.
onboarding.choice.ollama.title: On this computer (Ollama)
onboarding.choice.ollama.text: Nothing leaves the computer. Needs a recent computer (8 GB of memory recommended) and a 2 to 5 GB download.
onboarding.choice.anthropic.title: Claude (Anthropic)
onboarding.choice.anthropic.tag: API key · pay as you go
onboarding.choice.anthropic.text: Excellent at acting on the computer, sees the screen.
onboarding.choice.openai.title: GPT (OpenAI)
onboarding.choice.openai.tag: API key · pay as you go
onboarding.choice.openai.text: The model behind ChatGPT, sees the screen.
onboarding.choice.mistral.title: Mistral AI
onboarding.choice.mistral.text: European models, free tier to try.
onboarding.choice.openrouter.title: OpenRouter
onboarding.choice.openrouter.text: One key for Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama and many more.
onboarding.choice.ollama-cloud.title: Ollama Cloud
onboarding.choice.ollama-cloud.text: Large open models, in Ollama's cloud.
onboarding.key.label: Your {provider} key
onboarding.key.safe: The key is kept in the computer's keyring, never in plain text in a file.
onboarding.key.no_keyring: No keyring is available on this computer: the key cannot be saved.
onboarding.local.missing: Ollama is not installed yet. Open a terminal (Konsole) and run this command: it will ask for your password.
onboarding.local.missing_hint: Official command from ollama.com. Then come back and click “Check again”.
onboarding.local.stopped: Ollama is installed but not running. Start it in a terminal:
onboarding.local.stopped_hint: Or run “ollama serve”. Then click “Check again”.
onboarding.local.pick: Choose a model. This computer has {ram} GB of memory.
onboarding.local.failed: The model could not be downloaded: {error}
onboarding.voice.title: Talk to Kreafinity?
onboarding.voice.text: Kreafinity can listen and answer aloud. Recognition and voice run on the computer, nothing is sent (about 600 MB to download, in the background).
onboarding.voice.started: The voice is being prepared in the background.
onboarding.done.title: All set!
onboarding.done.shortcut: Meta + C (the Windows key and C) opens the assistant anywhere.
onboarding.done.approve: Every action on the computer is shown to you before it is done.
onboarding.done.settings: Settings let you change the AI, manage memory and voice.
onboarding.done.prompt1: What can you do for me?
onboarding.done.prompt2: Show me the 5 biggest files in my Downloads folder
onboarding.done.prompt3: Switch the desktop to the dark theme
mcp.title: Extensions (MCP)
mcp.text: More tools for the assistant, provided by MCP servers: calendar, mail, home automation, GitHub… Every tool asks for your approval before it runs, except the ones you tick.
mcp.remove_confirm: Remove the “{name}” extension and its secrets?
mcp.tools_hint: Tick the tools that may run without asking you:
mcp.add_text: A program speaking MCP (often “uvx …” or “npx -y …”, see the extension's documentation), or the address of an MCP server.
mcp.name: Short name
mcp.token_needed: The server (address) needs an access token
mcp.warning: An extension is a program running with your rights: only add extensions you trust.
live.listening: I'm listening… speak whenever you like.
live.approval: I need your approval: look at the screen.
approval.always_saved: Noted: this will be done without asking. You can change it in Settings › Permanent permissions.
settings.permissions.title: Permanent permissions
settings.permissions.text: Actions you allowed for good (“Always allow”): the AI does them without asking. They are still recorded in the action log, deletions go to the trash, and the system still asks your password for administrator actions. Beware: a web page or file read by the AI may hide instructions; only allow for good what you would accept to see done without you.
settings.permissions.empty: None yet: every action needing approval is shown to you first.
